newsitem.title: USA: JAX sees Q3 EPS at $0.07-$0.08/shr.
newsitem.headline: JAX sees Q3 EPS at $0.07-$0.08/shr.

text.p: Homebuilder JAX International Inc said Monday it expected to report earnings of $0.07 a share to $0.08 a share for the third quarter.
"(It will be) in line with our goal of having a 20 to 25 cents EPS by year's end," it said in a statement.
The company said it had received the financing and city approval to build a series of homes in Tulsa, Okla., enabling it to meet its goal of building a total of 90 homes by the end of the year.

"We're not going to have to build any spec houses," it said. "Everything we're building is sold and will be closed on by the buyers when construction is completed, adding dollars to the bottom line immediately."
